ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white central regions to low-intensity black margins and mottled features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation dominates the proximal (hinge) area and the entire periphery. Extensive low-intensity mottling and streaks are distributed across the white interior blocks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-based angle of 85 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Maximum pixel-amplitude variations are concentrated at the distal tips where irregular massing is visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast textured pixels (barnacle colonization) localized at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of parallel and unaligned linear dark pixel streaks. Notable clusters of diagonal rake marks on the left lobe and a prominent circular/curved linear marking on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring consisting of multi-directional rake marks across both lobes and significant biological encrustation (barnacles) at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular arc pigmentation/scarring pattern located in the upper-quadrant of the right lobe's white field.
